counting_policy: One repository ID equals one corpus item. Dagster monorepo packages do not count as additional repositories.
crawl_scale_note: Smoke check is public and unauthenticated. Current core/search response headers provide the available quota. A 600-repository corpus with metadata, commit, README and supporting content needs thousands of reads; an authenticated read-only GitHub identity is recommended to avoid the unauthenticated core quota. Search has a separate quota. Full crawl must coordinate rate limits across both agents.
